name: fno_coreg_residual
description: Novel hybrid: 4 per-fidelity FNOs + MFRNP-style decoder-in-the-aggregation (HF baseline = aggregator over upsampled decoded LFs) + continuous-m coregionalization basis-head on the HF latent (y_HF = agg + sum_k B_k(m) h_k(x), B(m)=MLP_B([m, m^2])). Per-fidelity output normalization; basis-head zero-initialised so the architecture starts as the pure aggregator and optimisation grows the residual.
